source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text:
Hey Joseph, id like to eliminate the big blocks and give that extra $1 to me, so it'll be:
$15 buy, $5 to me,  $5 to affiliate,  $5 to block prize pool.

Increases my bottom line with minimal impact on sales.
Plus it simplifies the game mechanics and marketing.

Giveing myself and each community member an even split, as well as everyone getting an even shot at the never ending $500 prizes seems aligned with the projects ethos.

value_updates.buyer_earnings_explanation: Explain the $5 commission and Small Block prize tickets while stating that any future BooksOnChain governance-token allocation depends on FAMM succeeding and has no guarantee of success or value.
value_updates.referral_explanation: Explain that a mint number is the permanent referral code, successful referrals award $5 plus a Small Block ticket, and a no-code mint sends the commission and Small Block ticket to a random existing NFT holder.
value_updates.prize_explanation: Explain the recurring $500 Small Block prizes funded by the block prize pool.
value_updates.ticket_explanation: Explain that referrals earn current-draw Small Block entries, that more tickets increase the chance of winning, and that tickets expire after the applicable draw.
value_updates.single_level_model_explanation: Explain that the model is single-level and source-verified on Basescan, that the founder receives $5 per primary mint minus applicable fiat fees and $4 per secondary sale, and that the remaining proceeds fund commissions and the Small Block prize pool.

how_it_works_copy.mint: Purchase the ebook NFT for $15 USD; the mint number is the referral code.
how_it_works_copy.referrals: Sharing the mint number or link earns an instant $5 USD for each referred mint, with no limit or expiration; when no code is used, the commission and Small Block ticket go to a random existing ticket holder.
how_it_works_copy.tickets: Each referral gives a Small Block prize ticket for the current block, and more referrals provide more chances to win.
how_it_works_copy.prizes: Small Block awards recurring $500 prizes, counting mint and secondary sales, with winners selected through Chainlink VRF.
how_it_works_copy.reward_collection: Commissions are sent automatically on-chain, while prize wins are announced on the Winners page and claimed with one click.
